one_line: Nvidia faces leadership changes, antitrust probes, and congressional investigations following CEO Jensen Huang's resignation.

themes.title: Nvidia leadership changes and U.S. probes
themes.text: Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang stepped down as CEO after reports of extramarital affairs, prompting Colette Kress to take over as interim CEO. The company now faces multiple U.S. Department of Justice probes, congressional investigations into China chip sales, and planned congressional testimony by Huang.

stories.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns; CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO
Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang agrees to testify before Congress by Thanksgiving
US DOJ opens antitrust and related probes involving Nvidia
Democrats launch Nvidia investigation into China chip sales and Trump deal
Senate Banking Chair Tim Scott asks Jensen Huang and Howard Lutnick to testify
US officials disagree on whether Alice Huang spied for China
Nvidia stopped reporting Singapore revenue after July 2025 blocklist
Congress prepares subpoena for Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang over spy affair

themes.title: Chinese AI labs seek overseas compute
themes.text: Chinese artificial intelligence companies are rushing to rent overseas Nvidia compute capacity amid fears of stricter U.S. export restrictions. Meanwhile, a forensic study found hardware fingerprints matching export-controlled Blackwell GPUs in six recent Chinese AI models.

stories.headline: Chinese AI firms rush to secure overseas Nvidia compute capacity amid US curb fears
Forensic analysis finds six Chinese AI models show NVIDIA Blackwell GPU fingerprints
Nvidia privately confirmed it could track chips to fight smuggling

themes.title: OpenAI and AI development grow in India
themes.text: India has become ChatGPT's largest market globally by weekly active users, prompting OpenAI to launch local API inference residency for businesses. Additionally, Chariot launched a new text-to-speech model supporting 11 Indian languages.

stories.headline: OpenAI adds API inference residency for GPT-6 Luna in India
Chariot launches multilingual TTS model with support for 11 Indian languages
India is now ChatGPT's largest market globally by weekly active users

themes.title: Major funding rounds and valuations
themes.text: SoftBank-led funding rounds and major public offerings saw Agile Robots reach an $8.5 billion valuation and LangChain reach $3 billion. Anthropic's upcoming IPO is significantly oversubscribed, and ByteDance planned a share buyback at a $400 billion valuation.

stories.headline: Agile Robots raises $500M led by SoftBank at $8.5B valuation
LangChain raises $300 million, valuation climbs to $3 billion
Anthropic IPO draws about six times the orders for available shares
ByteDance plans $6B share buyback at $400B valuation
